Window_Style.name: Window Style
Window_Style.description: Which glazing a building's upper floors get.

members.name: Punched
members.description: Framed windows set into solid wall.

members.name: Curtain Wall
members.description: Glass over almost the whole bay.

Bay_Grid.name: Window Grid
Bay_Grid.description: Window centres for a tile of Bays x Bays bays, each window shifted within its bay, plus a random lit subset.

Bench.name: Bench
Bench.description: A park bench: seat, leaning back and two end panels.

Block.name: Block
Block.description: A box of a given size, moved and tinted: the brick every prop is built from.

Building.name: Building
Building.description: One building: its facade with a roof on top.

Building_Colours.name: Building Colours
Building_Colours.description: One tint per building: a random palette pick, nudged by a random amount within a range.

Building_Looks.name: Building Looks
Building_Looks.description: Rolls each lot's colour, roof shade and window style.

Building_Part.name: Building Part
Building_Part.description: One extruded, textured, tinted piece of a building: walls strip-mapped at one bay per repeat.

Cone_Layer.name: Cone Layer
Cone_Layer.description: A tinted cone standing at a height: one tier of a conifer canopy.

Conifer.name: Conifer
Conifer.description: A layered conifer: trunk and two stacked cones.

Curb_Points.name: Curb Points
Curb_Points.description: One run of points along every sidewalk's curb line, split by coin flips into benches, lamps and hydrants.

Entrance_Trim.name: Entrance Trim
Entrance_Trim.description: An awning ring at door height and a signage band just above it, around a ground floor.

Facade.name: Facade
Facade.description: The shell of one building: a glazed ground floor, a base and, above the setback height, an inset tower.

Filter_Lots.name: Filter Lots
Filter_Lots.description: Keeps the lots big enough to build on, with their heights.

Glass_Gradient.name: Glass Gradient
Glass_Gradient.description: Wall white, frame grey and the glass colour, keyed to the window mask levels.

Grass_Material.name: Grass Material
Grass_Material.description: Perlin-noise grass colouring baked into a texture, as the ground material.

Grass_Points.name: Grass Points
Grass_Points.description: Two tree rows on the grass ring, each point a conifer or a round tree, and bush points near the road.

Hydrant.name: Hydrant
Hydrant.description: A fire hydrant: drum, domed cap and a nozzle bar.

Lamp_Post.name: Lamp Post
Lamp_Post.description: A street lamp: a slim pole and a glowing lantern head, instanced at the given transforms.

Massing.name: Massing
Massing.description: How one building splits into a ground floor, a base and a set-back tower, from its footprint and height.

Planting_Bed.name: Planting Bed
Planting_Bed.description: A thin mulch ring around the grass area, under the tree rows.

Prop_Model.name: Prop Model
Prop_Model.description: A mesh repeated at a list of transforms as GPU instances, with a plain matte material.

Ring_Points.name: Ring Points
Ring_Points.description: Transforms spaced along the outline of an area offset in or out, at a height.

Road_Markings.name: Road Markings
Road_Markings.description: A centre line along every road, cut short of the intersections.

Roof.name: Roof
Roof.description: A parapet ring and a mechanical penthouse on top of one building.

Roof_Clutter.name: Roof Clutter
Roof_Clutter.description: Air-handling units on a ring inside the parapet, by coin flip, and one water tank among the rest.

Roof_Materials.name: Roof Materials
Roof_Materials.description: Gravel for roofs and ledges, and a dark matte trim for awnings and signage.

Roof_Shell.name: Roof Shell
Roof_Shell.description: Parapet ring standing a lip proud of the wall, and a penthouse where the inset footprint keeps enough area.

Roof_Slab.name: Roof Slab
Roof_Slab.description: A thin gravel slab over a roof, textured at a fixed world repeat.

Roof_Unit.name: Roof Unit
Roof_Unit.description: A rooftop air-handling box, instanced at the given transforms.

Round_Tree.name: Round Tree
Round_Tree.description: A round-canopied tree: trunk and sphere.

Street_Furniture.name: Street Furniture
Street_Furniture.description: Trees and street lights spaced along the curb of every sidewalk, as GPU instances.

Trim_Band.name: Trim Band
Trim_Band.description: A thin ring around a footprint at a height: the footprint grown by Grow, minus Inner.

Wall_Shade.name: Wall Shade
Wall_Shade.description: Concrete grain and a slab line per bay row, as one float texture to multiply into a wall colour.

Water_Tank.name: Water Tank
Water_Tank.description: A rooftop water tank, a drum with a conical lid, instanced at the given transforms.

Window_Maps.name: Window Maps
Window_Maps.description: Colour, roughness, normal and glow images for a window tile.

Window_Mask.name: Window Mask
Window_Mask.description: Pane and frame rectangles as a float mask: wall 0, frame 0.5, glass 1; and the lit panes alone.

Window_Style.name: Window Style
Window_Style.description: One facade material: a tile of bays with framed panes, some lit, over grained concrete.

Window_Styles.name: Window Styles
Window_Styles.description: Builds the three facade styles and the storefront once, then hands back each building's material and bay in building order.
